description: This file is a configuration script for setting up a proxy server in a web frontend project, specifically for the Superset frontend. It manages proxying requests, handling HTML responses, and modifying headers for development purposes.

methods.name: isHTML
methods.description: Checks if the response content type is HTML.

methods.name: toDevHTML
methods.description: Modifies HTML content to include development-specific asset links and titles.

methods.name: copyHeaders
methods.description: Copies headers from the original response to the proxy response, with modifications for cookies and redirects.

methods.name: processHTML
methods.description: Processes HTML responses to replace asset links with local dev server assets, handling decompression if needed.
